description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named BuzzPostShareSearchFilterParams used within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin to encapsulate search filter parameters related to shared post IDs.

classes.name: BuzzPostShareSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO used to specify search filters for shared posts, specifically allowing filtering by post ID within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin.

methods.name: getPostId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the post to filter shares by; nullable integer.

methods.name: setPostId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the post to filter shares by; accepts nullable integer.
